description: This file defines a generic max-heap data structure implementation in C#, including supporting classes, interfaces, and methods for heap management such as insertion, removal, and heapify operations. It is used internally within the Orleans runtime for placement and repartitioning logic.

classes.name: CandidateVertexHeapElement
classes.description: Represents an element in the max-heap encapsulating a CandidateVertex, along with connected vertices and transfer scores.

classes.name: MaxHeap
classes.description: Implements a broad, array-backed quaternary max-heap data structure supporting various heap operations.

classes.name: IHeapElement
classes.description: Interface for heap elements that supports heap index management and comparison based on priority.

methods.name: Peek
methods.description: Returns the highest priority element without removing it from the heap.

methods.name: Pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the highest priority element from the heap.

methods.name: Heapify
methods.description: Transforms the current list of elements into a valid heap in-place.

methods.name: MoveUp
methods.description: Restores the heap property by moving an element up the tree.

methods.name: MoveDown
methods.description: Restores the heap property by moving an element down the tree.
